import {
  AUTH_HTTP_ERROR,
  AUTH_SESSION_ERROR,
  AUTH_COOKIE_ERROR,
  AUTH_SUCCESS
} from '../actions/authActions';

const initialState = {
        //main UI
        showMainAccordion: false,
        //signup
        showSignupSubmitButton: true,
        enableSignupSubmitButton: true,
        showSignupSubmitLoadingButton: false,
        enableSignupFormInputs: true,
        
        //login
        scUsername: '',
        scPassword: '',
        showLoginForm: false,
        showLoginSubmitButton: true,
        showLogoutSubmitButton: false,
        enableLoginSubmitButton: true,
        showLoginSubmitLoadingButton: false,
        loginHeaderText: 'Login',
        loggedInInfoText: '',
        showLoggedInInfo: false,
        
        //commenters
        commentersSearchUrl : '',
        commenterData : [],
        selectedCommenters : [],
        toggledClearRows: false,
        showCommentersSearchSubmitButton: true,
        enableCommentersSearchSubmitButton: false,
        showCommentersSearchSubmitLoadingButton: false,
        enableCommentersSearchInput: true,
        showCommentersSearchForm: false,
        showCommentersTable: false,
        
        //commentersmessages
        showCommentersMessageForm: false,
        commentersMessage : 'Hi <<profileName>>,',
        enableCommentersMessageSubmitButton: false,
        showCommentersMessageSubmitButton: true,
        showCommentersMessageSubmitLoadingButton: false,
        enableCommentersMessageInput: true,
     
        //followers
        followersSearchUrl : '',
        followerData : [],
        selectedFollowers : [],
        //toggledClearRows: false,
        showFollowersSearchSubmitButton: true,
        enableFollowersSearchSubmitButton: false,
        showFollowersSearchSubmitLoadingButton: false,
        enableFollowersSearchInput: true,
        showFollowersSearchForm: false,
        showFollowersTable: false,
        
  
        //alerts
        showErrorAlert: false,
        showSuccessAlert: false,
        showInfoAlert: false,
        errorAlertText: '',
        successAlertText: '',
        infoAlertText: '',
        infoAlertTextHeading: '',
        errorAlertLink: '',
        errorAlertLinkText: ''};

export default function authReducer(state = initialState, action) {
  
  switch(action.type) {

    case AUTH_HTTP_ERROR:
      
      return {
        ...state,
        authErrorMessage: action.error,
        errorAlertText: "Auth HTTP error. Please try again later.",
        showErrorAlert: true   
      };

    case AUTH_SESSION_ERROR:

      return {
        ...state,
        authErrorMessage: action.error,
        errorAlertText: "",
        showErrorAlert: false,
        showLoginForm: true,
        showLoginSubmitButton: true,
        infoAlertTextHeading: "Welcome",
        infoAlertText: "Please log in.",
        enableLoginSubmitButton: true,
        showInfoAlert: true                        
                              
      };
      
    case AUTH_COOKIE_ERROR:

      return {
        ...state,
        authErrorMessage: action.error,
        errorAlertText: "Auth cookie error. Please contact support.",
        showErrorAlert: true
      };
      
      case AUTH_SUCCESS:

      return {
        ...state,
        authErrorMessage: null,
        errorAlertText: null,
        showErrorAlert: false,            
        showLoggedInInfo: true,
        showLogoutSubmitButton: true,
        loggedInInfoText: "Logged in as " + action.scUsername,
        showMainAccordion: true,
        showCommentersSearchForm: true,
        showCommentersSearchSubmitButton: true,
        enableCommentersSearchSubmitButton: false, 
        enableCommentersSearchInput: true
                    
      };
      
      
    default:
      // ALWAYS have a default case in a reducer
      return state;
  }
}
